title: JoJo | KEY.co
description_expanded: Overlooking charming Ruskin Park in the heart of Seaside, this exquisitely renovated townhome blends artistic design with coastal comfort in one of 30A’s most coveted locations. Just a four-minute stroll to the beach and mere steps from Central Square, this two-bedroom, three-bath retreat offers over 2,700 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space. Owned by an interior decorator, every corner of the home reflects a designer’s touch—from vaulted ceilings and layered textures to luxury furnishings and statement lighting. Multiple outdoor spaces, including a spacious rear deck and two private balconies, provide inviting spots to enjoy the park views or sip your morning coffee beneath the trees of Fairy Forest. Inside, the home is made for both gathering and retreat. The open-concept living and dining area flows into a fully updated kitchen with stone countertops and stainless-steel appliances, while two distinct living rooms—plus a queen Murphy bed—offer flexible lounging and sleeping arrangements. Upstairs, the king primary suite opens onto a private veranda, while the second bedroom with twin beds and a built-in hallway bunk make this a perfect setup for families. With three resort pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and a private Seaside beach just minutes away, this stunning townhome is a true hidden gem for guests seeking both style and location in equal measure.
